metadata.title: Lithos 3D — Naturally on the bottom. Made of concrete and passion.
metadata.description: Innovative Method Feeder cages from reinforced concrete. Precision 3D printing, natural properties of concrete, zero lead.

hero.subtitle: We create innovative Method Feeder cages. We combine the precision of 3D printing with the natural properties of reinforced concrete. For your effectiveness and the cleanliness of our waters.

anatomy.title: What exactly is
anatomy.subtitle: This is not just another ordinary sinker. It's a thoughtful tool for Method Feeder anglers, combining natural camouflage with modern engineering.
anatomy.ecoconcrete: The main weight core made of non-absorbent, sinking material. Zero toxins in the water, perfect fit to the bottom.
anatomy.noGlare: The matte, porous structure doesn't scare fish — unlike smooth, shiny plastic or lead.
anatomy.wings: The precisely printed shell perfectly holds the bait during a strong cast and impact with the water.
anatomy.aero: Designed in CAD software for maximum distance and accuracy, regardless of wind.

mission.title: Why did we give up
mission.body: Fishing is about being close to nature, yet for years we have been poisoning it with thousands of tons of lead annually. Every broken rig is a toxic trace at the bottom of a lake that stays there for hundreds of years. We decided to change this without compromising on effectiveness.
mission.pillar0text: Our concrete has neutral pH and releases no toxic substances. It is safe for fish and the ecosystem.
mission.pillar1text: We use modern 3D printing to create aerodynamically perfect forms that hold bait exceptionally well.
mission.pillar2text: The entire design and production process takes place in Poland. You support local craft innovation.

process.title: How is
process.subtitle: From idea to cast on the water. A combination of engineering and traditional building materials.
process.step0desc: We design in 3D software, taking care of every millimeter of the feeder. We test aerodynamics and tab placement.
process.step1desc: We print precise matrix molds. 3D printing allows us details impossible to achieve with standard lead casting.
process.step2desc: We prepare a specialized concrete reinforced with microfibers. It provides resistance to water and impact against rocks.
process.step3desc: Finished feeders cure, gaining full hardness and the characteristic matte structure that camouflages them on the bottom.

features.title:
Designed
to
features.body: Lead shines and scares cautious fish. Concrete creates a natural structure that perfectly blends with the lake or river bottom. The fish only sees your bait.
features.check0: The non-absorbent concrete structure doesn't change weight during fishing.
features.check1: Fiber reinforcement prevents the feeder from crumbling.
features.check2: Ability to choose concrete color to match the bottom type (sand / silt).
features.check3: Price of traditional lead — without the ecological "tax".
